description: Rug-pull / honeypot score from 0 to 100 using GoPlus, DexScreener, and RugCheck on Solana. chain is ethereum, bsc, base, or solana (eth, bnb, and sol also work). Trusted tokens still list issuer-style flags but those flags do not add points. include_summary adds an InferHub paragraph. Paid tool: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 on eip155:8453. The first few calls each UTC day are free; after that an unpaid call returns PaymentRequired and does not charge.
name: rug_risk
